actions.name: light sensitivity
actions.desc: While in Bright Light, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item Attach]] attack and two [[/item Tail]] attacks.

actions.name: attach
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to it. While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is attached, the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=6iLqAufAeEqDOlGs]] feet of it can take an action to try to detach the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, doing so by succeeding on a DC [[lookup @check.dc.value activity=6iLqAufAeEqDOlGs]] Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: phantasms
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMirrorImag]{Mirror Image} spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

actions.name: moan
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Mng39fcFDc4I1AzY]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=Mng39fcFDc4I1AzY]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Mng39fcFDc4I1AzY]]-[[lookup @target.template.units activity=Mng39fcFDc4I1AzY]]. Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Moan for the next 24 hours.
